# Sirach Chapter 45 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 45 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**45:1** From Jacob he brought forth a man who found favor in the sight of all, beloved by God and men alike — Moses, whose memory is blessed.

**45:2** He made him equal in glory to the holy ones and made him great, so that his enemies stood in awe of him.

**45:3** By his word he made signs cease; he glorified him in the presence of kings, gave him commandments for his people, and showed him a portion of his glory.

**45:4** He sanctified him through faithfulness and meekness; he chose him from among all humanity.

**45:5** He made him hear his voice and led him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments face to face, the law of life and knowledge, so that he might teach Jacob the covenant and enlighten Israel with his decrees.

**45:6** He exalted Aaron, a holy man like Moses, his brother, of the tribe of Levi.

**45:7** He made an everlasting covenant with him and gave him the priesthood of the people; he adorned him with splendor and girded him about with a glorious robe.

**45:8** He clothed him in perfect glory and strengthened him with the symbols of authority: the linen breeches, the long robe, and the ephod.

**45:9** He surrounded him with pomegranates and with many gold bells all around, to sound with each step he took, to make their music heard in the temple as a reminder to the people.

**45:10** With the sacred vestment of gold and blue and purple, the work of a skilled embroiderer; with the oracle of decision, the Urim and Thummim;

**45:11** with twisted scarlet, the work of an artisan; with precious stones engraved like seals in settings of gold, the work of a jeweler — a memorial corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel;

**45:12** with a crown of gold upon his turban, engraved with the sacred inscription, a distinguished and glorious adornment, an object of delight for the eyes, beautiful beyond measure.

**45:13** Before him there were no such things. No outsider ever put them on; only his sons, and his descendants forever.

**45:14** His sacrifices were wholly burned twice each day, continually.

**45:15** Moses ordained him and anointed him with holy oil; it was an everlasting covenant for him and his descendants as long as the heavens endure, to serve as priest and bless his people and praise him by name.

**45:16** He chose him from among all the living to offer sacrifice to the Lord, incense and a pleasing aroma as a memorial offering, to make atonement for the people.

**45:17** In his commandments he gave him authority in statutes and judgments, to teach Jacob his testimonies and to enlighten Israel in his law.

**45:18** Outsiders plotted against him and envied him in the wilderness — the followers of Dathan and Abiram and the company of Korah, in their fury and rage.

**45:19** The Lord saw this and was not pleased, and they were consumed in the heat of his anger; he worked wonders against them, destroying them in blazing fire.

**45:20** And he multiplied the glory of Aaron and gave him his inheritance; he assigned him the first-fruits of the produce.

**45:21** He prepared their bread in abundance; they eat the sacrifices of the Lord — sacrifices he gave to him and his descendants.

**45:22** But in the land of the people he has no inheritance, and he has no portion among the people; for the Lord himself is his portion and his inheritance.

**45:23** Phinehas son of Eleazar is third in glory, zealous in the fear of the Lord; he stood fast when the people turned back, with the noble courage of his soul, and made atonement for Israel.

**45:24** Therefore a covenant of peace was established with him, that he should lead the sanctuary and his people, so that he and his descendants should hold the dignity of the priesthood forever.

**45:25** A covenant was also established with David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Judah: a royal inheritance passed from son to son alone; so the heritage of Aaron passes to his descendants alone.

**45:26** Now may God grant you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, so that their prosperity may not vanish and their glory may endure for all generations.
